provenance: The owner, 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-09 (docs/review/signal-symbols-worklist.md, Reference data and Rulings 2026-11-09; issue #80): a head's Style is its model. A row is head word to what the head does for it, one column per output the model has (lamp, arm); the right-hand side is the encoder's instruction, never a model fact. Each row's source names the worklist seed or the symbol's Description in Railroad-Field.kicad_sym.

TypeD.source: worklist seed 2026-11-04; Device-Head-TypeD Description: GRS Type D colour-light signal head

SA.source: worklist seed 2026-11-04 (the TypeD table); Device-Head-SA Description: GRS SA searchlight signal head

H2.source: worklist seed 2026-11-04 (the TypeD table); Device-Head-H2 Description: US&S H-2 searchlight signal head

UQ3.source: worklist seed 2026-11-04 (UQ) with the arm positions named by the Style (the owner, 2026-11-09); Device-Head-Semaphore-UQ3 Description: 3-position Upper-quadrant semaphore signal head

LQ2.source: worklist seed 2026-11-04 (LQ); Device-Head-Semaphore-LQ2 Description: 2-position Lower-quadrant semaphore signal head

LQ3.source: Device-Head-Semaphore-LQ3 Description: 3-position Lower-quadrant semaphore signal head (three arm positions, so the three running words); the lamp column as LQ2's; the arm angles are not stated (unverified)
